note.en: A large bigeye of rocky bottoms deeper than about 40 m, listed by FishBase for Costa Rica without local records.
note.es: Una catalufa grande de fondos rocosos a más de unos 40 m, listada por FishBase para Costa Rica sin registros locales.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic
